**My favorite memory of 2025:**

One of the most meaningful moments of 2025 was being part of the Positive School Conference with MNPS and seeing the power of student centered, strength based practices come to life. Watching educators, leaders, and community partners come together around a shared commitment to belonging, positive behavior, and student voice was deeply affirming. It reminded me how impactful it is when schools lead with compassion, consistency, and high expectations for every child. That experience reinforced why this work matters and how much change is possible when systems and people align.

**What I’m looking forward to in 2026:**

In 2026, I am especially excited about the next year’s AON Awards and the opportunity to celebrate schools, educators, and leaders who are setting the standard for positive school culture. Honoring the work that often happens quietly but transforms entire communities feels incredibly important. I am looking forward to amplifying those stories, recognizing excellence, and continuing to support the momentum toward schools where every student feels seen, supported, and empowered to thrive.
